create_string_recognizer: create a StringRecognizer from an EBNF grammar encoding to validate strings against the grammar
accept_string_with_recognizer: test if a string is fully accepted by the StringRecognizer grammar using _accept_string
accept_prefix_with_recognizer: test if a string is a valid prefix of the grammar using _accept_prefix
update_state_with_bytes: update the parsing state progressively by feeding bytes one at a time using _update_state_with_bytes
expand_stack_head_recognizer: expand non-terminal references on the stack into their rule alternates using expand_stack_head
